plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 11th house: they bring commitment to your friendships and future; durable loyalty and shared goals, or a damper on your social life. Failure mode: feeling restricted in your circle. Build the future together; keep your other connections.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
